capabilities: upload local files to Google Drive via OAuth
insert embed code for uploaded files at the cursor
choose embed sizes for video, audio, documents, and images
configure OAuth credentials, Drive folder, and default sizes in settings
extras: Files uploaded to Google Drive are set to public sharing, which the README notes is required for embedding. Installation is currently via BRAT, not the community plugin registry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to host large media files off the vault and embed them directly from Google Drive.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT plugin - Open Obsidian Settings → BRAT → Add Beta plugin

requires.name: Google OAuth Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Google Drive uploader that uploads local vault files to Drive and inserts embeds for video, audio, PDF, and images with size options.
